product.name: Monoprice Commercial Audio 60W 3ch 100/70V Mixer Amp with Bluetooth
product.description: Enjoy quality Bluetooth® wireless technology music playback and paging ability with this 60‑watt 3‑channel 100/70V Mixer Amp with Bluetooth® from Monoprice. Small to medium sized businesses will benefit from the compact size of this high power music and paging audio amplifier with a 3‑channel mixer. Choose from 1/4" or XLR mic inputs and RCA or 1/4" line inputs for playback of cable boxes or juke boxes. USB playback is available for controlled playback or enjoy streaming music from your mobile device using Bluetooth connectivity. Choose high‑fidelity 4~8 ohm speakers or install 100/70V distributed audio speakers for more coverage of your facility. Control USB and Bluetooth® playback using the included IR remote control.Features: Compact public address amplifierSupports 4‑ohm, 8‑ohm, and 16‑ohm passive speakersSupports 70‑volt and 100‑volt constant voltage speaker systemsDelivers 60‑watts into a 4‑ohm loadBuilt‑in mp3 player, FM tuner, and Bluetooth® connectionIncludes 1/4" unbalanced and XLR balanced microphone inputsSupports phantom power for condenser microphonesIncludes two line inputs and one line outputFeatures an EMC priority inputIncludes short circuit, clipping, overload, and over temperature protection circuitsCan accept 100 ~ 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz or 24 VDC, 4A input powerSupport Files: User's Manual (Jun 5, 2019)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. The Bluetooth® word mark and logos are registered trademarks of Bluetooth SIG, Inc.
